intro: Acne scars are what stay behind after the breakouts have gone: dark or red marks, and the pitted ice-pick, boxcar and rolling scars that catch the light and show through make-up or a beard. Many patients in Pune reach Skin Essence years after their acne settled, still avoiding close-up photographs.

There is no single scar treatment because there is no single scar type. Dr. Daksha Patel, an MD dermatologist with 17+ years of experience, maps the scars on your face first. Boxcar scars and rough texture respond to fractional CO2 laser resurfacing, deep ice-pick scars to TCA cross, tethered rolling scars to subcision, and shallow scars and open pores to microneedling. Most people have a mix, so most plans combine two or three of these.

Active acne is brought under control before scar work begins, otherwise new scars keep forming while old ones are treated. Sessions at our Kalyani Nagar clinic are spaced weeks apart, and improvement builds gradually as new collagen forms over three to six months. We tell you honestly what degree of improvement to expect for your scar types before you commit.
whoIsItFor: Pitted ice-pick, boxcar or rolling scars on the cheeks, temples or jawline left after acne
Dark or red marks that have not faded months after the breakouts cleared
Uneven, bumpy skin texture from years of acne
Adults whose acne is now under control and who want to treat what it left behind
Patients preparing for a wedding or event with at least 4 to 6 months in hand

howItWorks.title: Scar mapping
howItWorks.description: Under magnification we classify each scar type, check for active acne and pigmentation, and photograph the area so progress can be measured session by session.

howItWorks.title: Priming the skin
howItWorks.description: A short course of prescription creams and daily sunscreen prepares the skin, lowering the risk of darkening after procedures on Indian skin types.

howItWorks.title: Procedures
howItWorks.description: Depending on the map: fractional CO2 laser to resurface boxcar scars and texture, TCA cross for ice-pick scars, subcision to release tethered rolling scars, and microneedling to stimulate collagen across the area.

howItWorks.title: Review and maintenance
howItWorks.description: Sessions are spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart. Results are reviewed with photographs at each visit and the plan is adjusted as the scars respond.

sessionsAndDowntime.downtime: 2–5 days of redness or pinpoint scabs; up to a week after fractional CO2 laser
sessionsAndDowntime.results: Gradual improvement over 3–6 months as collagen rebuilds

aftercare: Expect redness and a sunburn-like feel for 24 to 48 hours. Tiny scabs after microneedling fall off within a week.
No make-up for 24 hours, no scrubs or active ingredients for a week, and sunscreen every morning without fail.
Do not pick at scabs or peeling skin; this can leave new marks.
Avoid the gym, swimming and steam for 48 hours after each session.

faqs.q: Can acne scars be removed completely?
faqs.a: Pitted scars can be improved substantially, often by half or more across a course, but not erased. Flat dark marks respond better and can fade almost fully. We show you realistic outcomes for your scar types before starting.

faqs.q: Which treatment is right for my scars?
faqs.a: It depends on the type. Boxcar scars respond to fractional CO2 laser, ice-pick scars to TCA cross, rolling scars to subcision, and shallow scars and open pores to microneedling. Dark marks fade with peels and laser toning. Most patients need a combination, planned after scar mapping.

faqs.q: Are fractional CO2 laser and microneedling suitable for Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes, with proper priming and aftercare. Indian skin can darken after procedures, so we prepare the skin beforehand, choose laser settings and needle depths carefully, and insist on daily sunscreen.

faqs.q: How soon after acne can I start scar treatment?
faqs.a: Marks can be treated as soon as active acne is under control. Procedures for pitted scars usually begin once the skin has been clear for a few months and any isotretinoin course has been completed.
Numbing cream is applied before microneedling, subcision and TCA cross, so you feel pressure and warmth rather than pain. Peels tingle for a few minutes and then settle.
